Ivy Nguyen: Aurum Inc goes live on dedicated pool Thurs 09:00 PST. They're expecting 150 rps steady, 600 rps peak. Committed 3xA100-equivalent. Main asks: fast warmup plan, autoscale thresholds, and a short smoke runbook. Also flagged renewal sensitivity on unit cost.
Diego Morales: I'll take warmup + smoke. Proposal: prefix prime 500 requests, then 3 ramp windows (20%, 60%, 100%) over 1 day, final 30m soak at 70% peak. Canary: 2% traffic for 15m pre-cutover.
Rina Kaur: Model strategy: primary redwood/opt-8-prod, fallback redwood/opt-6-q8. Enable KV caching size=16 tokens. Autoscale knobs: target GPU util 62%, scale up at 78%, backlog threshold 3500 tokens. Scale-down: below 45% for 4m.
Ivy Nguyen: @Diego own canary rollback. @Rina publish fallback and post model hash. I'll prepare AE renewal notes focusing on cost levers.
Diego Morales: k6 snippet for soak:
```
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 30m --out json=aurum_soak.json aurum_probe.js
```
Will upload results to shared drive. Also plan a low-blast failure inject: cordon one GPU during canary.
Rina Kaur: Pushed fallback to catalog, model_hash: sha256:ab9d2c1e... Bench shows ~25% token cost reduction, quality drop ~4% on eval set.
